probes.setup: Benchmark private HOME and XDG directories with no saved cities; Weather takes its empty-settings path and requests focus for the city search field.
Benchmark private HOME and XDG directories seeded with one saved city and one valid forecast cache whose fetched_at timestamp was current at launch; no network fetch was needed for the idle sample.

interpretation: The large difference tracks the empty first-run/search-focus state. The source schedules focused InputState caret blinking every 500 ms; the saved-city state does not focus search and is below the 0.3% app idle budget despite the minute-aligned local-time notification. One sample per state is directional evidence, not a stable estimate of a population mean. No UI change was made because first-run autofocus is an intentional keyboard-first behavior.
